mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_session (session_id, user_id, eid, title, status, last_active_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{eid}, #{title}, #{status}, #{lastActiveTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_active_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_ai_session WHERE eid = #{eid} AND user_id IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_active_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_session SET title = #{title} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE t_ai_session SET last_active_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE t_ai_session SET status = #{status} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE t_ai_session SET user_id = #{userId} WHERE eid = #{eid} AND user_id IS NULL
